message.content: {"action":"decrease_table_capacity","reason":"The current best-quality point is the LUT depth 256, linear, phase_bits 16 design (SQNR 82.1 dB, area 1584.6 um2). Since precision is already at a high level and further precision/interpolation moves are unavailable, reducing LUT depth is the most direct way to trade a modest amount of numerical quality for lower mapped area while staying in the same LUT/linear architecture."}
